Ananya welcomes Ravi with her open left hand while her right hand rests on the desk. This is the reverse of the record and is the known, accepted deviation. Both hands are well formed and the gesture clearly points toward Ravi.

Ravi's right hand rests on his knee and his left hand, with the watch, holds the chair armrest, which matches the record. The bag sits on the floor beside the chair, which matches the shoulder-bag 'during' state. His relaxed smile fits 'Ravi sits'.

The closed laptop is pushed to the left edge of the desk, and a window with a trailing pothos is behind them. There are no charts, text or instruments. This fits the consultation section and the source line 'Dr. Ananya greets Ravi in a consultation room.'
Costumes match page 3, so this reads as the same visit. Ananya on the left and Ravi on the right set the screen direction that 04-3 follows.
